config_path_hints: Remote server: Customize → Connectors → + Add → Add custom connector
notes: The streamable HTTP server is added in the app, not in the JSON file: enter name and URL in the custom connector dialog and add the Authorization header under Request headers (fixed credentials sent on every request). Alternatively sign in with OAuth instead of a header. The server must be reachable over the public internet from Anthropic's IP ranges. The JSON file only takes local stdio servers (command/args); after editing it, quit Claude Desktop completely (Cmd-Q on macOS) and start it again — the app reads it once at launch.
